construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written directly for this isolated build.

input.profile: Object with unique string arrays interests and completed_actions
input.actions: Up to 100 objects: id, title, topics string array, prerequisites action-ID array

output.status: ok for valid input, including when a journey is unavailable
output.recommendations: All immediately eligible uncompleted actions: action_id, title, score, matched_interests
output.journey: status ready or unavailable; steps array; reason null when ready, explanatory string otherwise
output.step: Recommendation metadata plus one-based position and sorted prerequisites

shared_schema.errors: Single JSON object with status error and error text; exit code 2
shared_schema.validation: Shared ValidationError, require and field/type helpers; strict unknown-field rejection, unique arrays and IDs, valid references, acyclic graph and prerequisite-closed completed history. Output validated against input before serialization.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated profile and catalog feed immediate eligibility and interest scoring.
Each possible first action is provisionally added to completed history to compute valid second actions.
The selected pair passes output validation, rechecking both steps sequentially against the same catalog. No completion state is persisted.

behavior.personalization: Score equals count of exact, case-sensitive matching interest topics.
behavior.recommendations_order: Descending score then ascending action ID.
behavior.journey_selection: Maximize sum of two step scores, then first-step score, then ascending first and second action IDs.
behavior.prerequisites: All prerequisites are mandatory. Steps are distinct and cannot already be completed.
behavior.unavailable: Return empty steps, never a partial journey, if no valid two-step pair exists.
behavior.determinism: Catalog input ordering does not affect output; topics and prerequisites in output are sorted.
behavior.json: Duplicate JSON keys, nonstandard constants, malformed JSON, invalid encoding and file errors are rejected.
behavior.fixtures: All example titles explicitly labeled Synthetic; no real users or products.

included: One integrated deterministic personalized discovery CLI
Exhaustive bounded two-step selection and validation
excluded: Enterprise service hosting, authentication, recommendation training

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status ok and journey status ready
cli.error_cases: Missing file and incorrect arguments verified in subprocesses: JSON status error, exit 2.
